text:
maya: Heads-up: eu-west1 embeddings spiking 503s since 21:40 UTC. I have a small restartless hotfix (hotfix/kv-guard-1.2.6) that fixes a race in KV eviction. Requesting expedited change window 21:55-22:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: /deploy request created repo=rl-inference ref=hotfix/kv-guard-1.2.6 env=eu-west1 strategy=restartless-canary id=DBOT-11422

ops-lead: Please attach runbook + gating thresholds. Need rollback steps and PD hooks before I can sign off.

sre-oncall: Quick risk note: code delta very small. Operational risk: short p99 blip during cache re-warm. Rollback plan: pin to v1.2.4 + run `kubectl job run-kvclear --image=ops/kvclear:stable --env=eu-west1`. Triggers: error-rate >2% for 5m OR p99 >900ms for 5m.

prudence: Proposed canary: 1% / 10m -> 10% / 8m -> 100%. Auto-fallback on triggers.

release-manager: Draft note prepared: "hotfix(embeddings): mitigate intermittent 503s in eu-west1 (v1.2.6)". Will publish post-deploy.

maya: Runbook + dashboard links: https://runbooks/kv-guard-1.2.6 and https://metrics/embeddings?region=eu-west1. Rollback CLI snippet in runbook.

ops-lead: Runbook validated, PD escalation in place. Ops approved if SRE oncall monitors.

sre-oncall: Im on pager and will watch p99/errors. If thresholds breach Ill post "rollback intent" and trigger pin.

deploy-bot: T-minus 6m to scheduled start. Any objections?
maya: none, go ahead.

deploy-bot: STARTED DBOT-11422  rolling 1% canary. status: https://deploys/dbot/11422/status

deploy-bot: CANARY CHECK (5m): errors 0.5% (baseline 0.2%), p99 +100ms. within gates.

maya: logs look clean, no new stack traces.

sre-oncall: monitoring ok. holding.

deploy-bot: PROMOTED to 10% after canary window.

deploy-bot: 10% running  observing 8m.

ops-lead: saw a transient spike at +2m but it recovered quickly. still within threshold.

prudence: timers clear, ready for final promote.

deploy-bot: PROMOTING to 100% now.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: v1.2.6 at 100% in eu-west1. No fallback triggered. Audit: https://deploys/dbot/11422/audit

release-manager: Changelog published and support notified. Tag: v1.2.6.

maya: thanks everyone  closing thread.

ops-lead: nice quick turnaround, good coordination. :tada:
